The town is part of the [[Naugatuck Valley Planning Region, Connecticut|Naugatuck Valley Planning Region]]. The population was 16,748 at the [[2020 United States census|2020 census]].{{Cite web| url=https://data.census.gov/cedsci/profile?g=0600000US0900967610| title=Census - Geography Profile: Seymour town, New Haven County, Connecticut| publisher=[[United States Census Bureau]]| access-date=December 21, 2021}} Seymour is bordered by the towns of [[Oxford, Connecticut|Oxford]] and [[Beacon Falls, Connecticut|Beacon Falls]] to the north, [[Bethany, Connecticut|Bethany]] and [[Woodbridge, Connecticut|Woodbridge]] to the east, [[Ansonia, Connecticut|Ansonia]] and [[Derby, Connecticut|Derby]] to the south, and [[Shelton, Connecticut|Shelton]] to the west.
